سَمَاوَةٌ : see سَمَآءٌ, in three places. ―
-b2- Also The form, or figure, seen from a distance, (S, M, K, TA,) [or] such as is high, or elevated, (TA,) of anything; (S, M, K, TA;) and the aspect thereof: pl. [or rather coll. gen. n.] ↓ سَمَآءٌ and ↓ سَمَاوٌ ; the latter mentioned by Ks. (M, TA.) El-'Ajjáj says, “سَمَآوَةُ الهِلَالِ حَتَّى ٱحْقَوْقَفَا
” [The form, &c., of the moon when near the change, until it became curved]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
